author: tedcruz
text:
We just had a tremendous bipartisan vote in the Senate to advance the Protect College Sports Act. Seventy-four senators voted to move forward.

That bipartisan vote is a major step toward protecting student athletes, bringing order to college sports, and preserving the institution.

I’m confident the Senate will pass it with a big bipartisan vote, the House will pass it, and we’ll put it on the president’s desk.
